rigel-v2.note: Laboratory command registry (profiles/gabo/cli/**): 10 commands materialized only into the lab deployment by apply-v2-runtime-service.sh. It is NOT a published bin (package.json has no rigel-v2 bin) and must never be presented as a product CLI. The public human route is the lifecycle installer profiles/gabo/rigel-v2-user-install.mjs (verbs: install, upgrade, rollback, uninstall, status).

omo.note: Parent Oh My OpenCode product. `omo setup`, `omo doctor` etc. belong to the parent and do not configure Oh My Rigel.

slash.note: In-chat slash commands registered by the OpenCode plugin.

install.documentedByCatalog: curl -fsSL https://get.omo.dev/install.sh | bash ; bunx oh-my-openagent install ; uninstall/cleanup
install.productParent: The catalog's install/uninstall text describes the PARENT Oh My OpenCode install path.
install.omrReal: Oh My Rigel's real install is the source lifecycle: `script/agent/setup.sh` then `node profiles/gabo/rigel-v2-user-install.mjs install --version 1`. See OH-MY-RIGEL.md.

warnings.text: `omo setup` belongs to the parent Oh My OpenCode product and does NOT configure Oh My Rigel.
`rigel setup` does not exist today. It is a future UX improvement, not a publication requirement; the web must not announce it.

The catalog's install/uninstall command text corresponds to the PARENT product; Oh My Rigel installs from source via script/agent/setup.sh + rigel-v2-user-install.mjs. Preserved 1:1 from the catalog and flagged for W6/W7.
